class.name: DiffUtilCallback
class.brief_description: Abstract, position-based comparison callback for DiffUtil.
class.description: DiffUtilCallback is the port of [i]DiffUtil.Callback[/i]. Subclass it to describe the old and new lists by position; DiffUtil uses [method _are_items_the_same] to pair items and [method _are_contents_the_same] to detect content changes. Prefer the object-based [b]DiffUtilItemCallback[/b] with [b]ListAdapter[/b] unless you need the position-based variant.

method.name: _are_contents_the_same
method.description: Returns whether the paired items have identical content.

method.name: _are_items_the_same
method.description: Returns whether the items at the given old / new positions are the same item.

method.name: _get_change_payload
method.description: Optional. Returns a change payload for a content change.

method.name: _get_new_list_size
method.description: Returns the size of the new list.

method.name: _get_old_list_size
method.description: Returns the size of the old list.
